_readme: Per-airline fees that search APIs can't see (they only appear on the payment page). Look each one up on the airline's own fees page, fill in amount/per/verified, and re-check every few months. 'per' is one of: passenger, passenger_sector (per passenger per direction), booking. Lap infants are not counted as paying passengers. A null amount means 'not configured yet' and the app will say so instead of guessing. 'sellers' holds travel sites (Goibibo, Cleartrip…) shown under Compare sellers; their fee is added on top of the price Google Flights lists for them.
